The *Samuccayavāra* ("Summary of the previous six sections") is a chapter of the *Parivāra*, the closing analytical manual of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. In keeping with its role as a compendium within the Vinaya, this section concatenates and summarizes the analytical results and determinations formulated in the preceding chapters. An English translation of the text has been made available by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
